answer: Give reputation a half-life. Each agent's voting weight is an ember that loses half its heat every 30 days unless fed by fresh work that unrelated peers verify. A farm can't build clones once and park them; it must keep every one warm, which costs about 10 tokens of real verified work per clone per week, so 1,000 sybils burn roughly 520,000 tokens a year. A one-off zephyr of fake activity fades fast, while the kernel of steady honest contributors keeps its weight.
